synopsis: RUGD is identified as a machine-mounted off-road dataset alongside RELLIS-3D [f12815]. Chapter 7 states that RUGD, RELLIS-3D, GOOSE and TartanDrive were not verified in this research [f5849]. Both Chapter 7 and the glossary report that no validation for off-road collision warning was found for these datasets; Chapter 7 extends that finding to CARLA, Gazebo and Isaac Sim [f5851, f12816]. The corpus therefore leaves RUGD’s suitability for off-road collision-warning validation unestablished, rather than demonstrating that it is unsuitable [f5849, f5851, f12816].

relations.note: Both report no collision-warning validation found for the four datasets; Chapter 7 also includes simulators.
The glossary specifies collision-warning validation as the missing verification.
The glossary identifies RUGD and RELLIS-3D as machine-mounted datasets within the unverified group.
Specifies the validation gap and extends its scope to three open-source simulators.
